provenance: Newly rendered reconstructed continuation; not resumed original V17 frames

runtime.derivation: Current renderer's configure_renderer method, captured through a no-GL backend; no draw

cache.approximation: Spatial trilinear density and density-weighted optical depth; standalone procedural source retained

png_sequence.scope: PNG pixels and recorded provenance verified; float buffers are not retained and cannot be rechecked from PNGs

video.frame_hash_algorithm: MD5 of decoded RGB24 pixels (ffmpeg framemd5)
video.scope: Full strict decode, dimensions, cadence, count, and uniqueness; lossy encoding changes pixels, so decoded MP4 hashes are not equated to PNG hashes
